answers.q: I'm new, where do I start?
a: Start with the free AI at Work: Day 1 Free Starter — Your First Shortcut. In about 15 minutes you check what your company allows, set the privacy settings that matter, learn the placeholder habit (swap real names and numbers for [CLIENT], [AMOUNT]) and turn rough bullets into a send-ready email.

Then grab the free 10 AI Prompts for Work — Free Shortcut Pack PDF: 10 copy-paste prompts for emails, meetings, reports and planning. Both work with the free versions of ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Claude.
Try the Day 1 email prompt right now:

answers.q: Which AI tool do I need?
a: No paid plan needed. Our guides work with the free versions of ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot or Claude.
Check your company's AI policy first. If your employer gives you an approved tool (a Business, Enterprise or Workspace account, or Microsoft Copilot through work), use that one for work data.
Then pick one assistant and stick with it for a week so you learn it properly. That's step 1 of the free Day 1 Starter.
Want plans and privacy settings side by side? The ChatGPT + Gemini Workday Cheat Sheet — One-Page Shortcuts ($5) covers which plan you actually need and where the privacy settings are for work.

answers.q: How do I use a prompt?
a: Copy it, replace the [BRACKETS] with your details, paste it into your AI chat. Then reply "shorter", "warmer" or "try again" until it sounds like you.
Use placeholders like [CLIENT] and [AMOUNT] instead of real names or numbers, and always check the output: AI can be confidently wrong.
Here's one from our free pack to try:

prompt.title: Notes to summary
prompt.text:
Turn these raw meeting notes into: (1) a 3-sentence summary, (2) decisions made, (3) action items as a table with owner and due date, (4) open questions.
[PASTE NOTES OR TRANSCRIPT]

answers.q: Is it safe to use AI with work data?
a: Follow your employer's AI policy. Don't paste confidential or customer data into tools your company hasn't approved. Turning off training is not the same as your company approving the tool.

Use placeholders like [CLIENT] and [AMOUNT] instead of real names or numbers. The free Day 1 Starter walks you through the privacy settings in ChatGPT and Gemini, and the Cheat Sheet shows where they are.

answers.q: Does it work on my phone?
a: Yes. The PDFs are designed for phone screens. Copy a prompt, paste it into your AI app, and fill in the brackets.
